verdict.rationale: The only real bulk mechanism is Store Sync catalog ingestion: merchants publish a whole catalog as a CSV/TSV/PSV feed of up to 4 GB, one row per variant, and partner on-ramps can sync listings. The agent toolkit and MCP tools (create_product, create_refund, accept_dispute_claim, create_order) all act on one item per call, and list_disputes only reads in bulk. Missing for 10: batch or bulk agent operations (bulk refunds, bulk product updates, bulk order or invoice actions), any documented batch API endpoints, and hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.
